create_BoltSummary: create a BoltSummary dataclass instance from a list of BoltJobSummary objects
check_BoltSummary_is_success: check if a BoltSummary has zero failures using the is_success property
get_BoltSummary_failed_job_names: get a list of failed job names from a BoltSummary using the failed_job_names property
count_BoltSummary_num_failures: count the number of failed jobs in a BoltSummary using the num_failures property
inspect_BoltSummary_failed_job_summaries: inspect the list of failed BoltJobSummary objects from a BoltSummary instance
